summary: can't donate to thunderbird using the paypal link, cross site error using firefox.
description:
User Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:107.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/107.0

Steps to reproduce:

- from here:
https://www.thunderbird.net/en-US/thunderbird/102.0/eoy/
- I click donate. Then from here:
https://give.thunderbird.net/en-US/?utm_source=thunderbird-client&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=about-dialog
- After the Paypal button appears I click it. Nothing happens.
In the console is an error cross site error.

Actual results:

Content Security Policy: The page’s settings blocked the loading of a resource at https://bpp.eset.com/en-US/Redirect-Switch?token=cccdfd7e637acc17d05fe4bd (“connect-src”).
Cross-Origin Request Blocked: The Same Origin Policy disallows reading the remote resource at https://www.paypal.com/xoplatform/logger/api/logger. (Reason: CORS request did not succeed). Status code: (null).

Expected results:

I think a window or new paypal page should appear so I can give you my money.

Using FireFox version 107.0 (64-bit) Windows 10. 
I also tried IE and Chrome.
